status: experimental private genuine R0 CPU fixed states consumed by real bounded graphics pipeline construction

states.blend: Genuine R0 owns exact FALSE/TRUE alpha-to-coverage, target0 replication or all8 independent target states, supported ordinary RGB/alpha factors/ops and all write masks. Inactive target fields are ignored only when replication is selected. Logic and dual-source classes remain refused. Original scalar FixedPlan/BlendPlan and292-byte MrtPlan layouts stay unchanged.
states.rasterizer: Solid or wireframe with exact NONE/FRONT/BACK culling and FALSE/TRUE front-counterclockwise state; depth clipping/scissor remain required. Wireframe CPU state uses a validated added flag and actual selected fillModeNonSolid gates all scalar/MRT/coverage pipeline paths. Original default flags3 and all scalar/MRT record layouts stay fixed. Clamp/bias, advanced line/conservative and broader classes remain unfinished.
states.depth_stencil: Depth supports all eight comparisons and ZERO/ALL writes. Stencil supports independent front/back enable, all comparison/fail/depth-fail/pass operations, and shared UINT8 read/write masks. Inactive faces use ALWAYS/KEEP and write mask zero. A 64-bit normalized owner retains all state without field truncation.
states.element_layout: Zero to32 snapshotted elements, original R0 InputRegister/slot fields, explicit or per-slot APPEND offsets, native R32 FLOAT/UINT/SINT scalar/2/3/4-vector formats, PER_VERTEX step0 and PER_INSTANCE step1. Checked register uniqueness, slot class consistency, four-byte alignment and bounded2048-byte extents. Other formats/divisors and unaligned/overlapping-stride emulation remain unsupported.

ownership: Typed fresh cross-kind runtime keys pin exact native device. All four identities and bounded reference counts validate before atomic constructor reference acquisition. Retirement is busy while leased. Actual Vulkan graphics construction consumes generated normalized FixedPlan; success bakes states and releases CPU state leases, failure destroys local pipeline first.
limitations: General blending permutations and vertex input remain incomplete.
No complete mandatory native device table or public DDI advertisement.

single_target_blending.normalization: Genuine R0 blend descriptors admit all RGBA write masks0..15; disabled mode ignores unused factor/operation fields. Enabled mode validates independent RGB/alpha factors and ADD/SUBTRACT/REV_SUBTRACT/MIN/MAX. Alpha factors ending COLOR are rejected. A checked packed u32 stores immutable owned state; bit31 and all unrecognized/unsupported codes refuse.
single_target_blending.supported_factors: ZERO, ONE, SRC_COLOR, INV_SRC_COLOR, SRC_ALPHA, INV_SRC_ALPHA, DEST_ALPHA, INV_DEST_ALPHA, DEST_COLOR, INV_DEST_COLOR, SRC_ALPHA_SAT for RGB; alpha excludes COLOR factors. Constant BLEND_FACTOR/INV_BLEND_FACTOR are supported: RGB selects constant color/inverse; alpha selects constant alpha/inverse.
single_target_blending.backend: A separate internal normalized BlendPlan preserves old FixedPlan and private bundle/query ABI sizes. Exact constructor leases freeze blend fields. Actual selected Vulkan format must advertise COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BLEND when enabled. C maps D3D enums to real VkBlendFactor/VkBlendOp and passes actual enable/factor/operation/write-mask fields to graphics pipeline creation.
single_target_blending.lifetime: Only successful actual pipeline creation bakes state. Temporary fixed/shader inputs are held through constructor and partial output destruction, then released. Caller descriptor mutation after native blend creation does not alter the owned state.
single_target_blending.remaining: Dual-source shaders/factors, alpha-to-coverage, independent MRTs, logic operations, format-capability publication and full public native qualification are incomplete.

dynamic_blend_constants.default: New/reset native command lists start with exact float bits for{1,1,1,1}. A NULL setter resets to that value.
dynamic_blend_constants.snapshot: Copy all four scalar caller bits during genuine callback. Repeated calls replace the snapshot; no pointer survives, and there is no global CPU clamp. Vulkan performs actual attachment-format-dependent conversion. The same state is stored when current PSO does not consume constants.
dynamic_blend_constants.lifetime: A separate internal BlendConstants record preserves existing private DirectState and bundle layouts. Move and restore by-value state with recording owners through retry, accepted/uncertain pending execution, reset and caller retirement. Setter commits use native phase/generation/fault admission.
dynamic_blend_constants.backend: Actual graphics PSOs enable VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_BLEND_CONSTANTS. Actual vkCmdSetBlendConstants precedes both color-only and depth/stencil draws. Missing entry point refuses before an attempt, retaining the closed recording for retry.
dynamic_blend_constants.remaining: General multi-draw command streams, bundles, independent MRTs and full public native/GPU qualification remain unfinished.

vertex_input_ownership: Typed layout owns an immutable normalized scalar array. Native PSO construction retains its exact generation, matches actual stored shader register/component signatures and requires the retained root IA permission. The selected Vulkan physical format buffer features and vertex limits are checked before creating actual attribute/binding state; baked PSOs retain no caller array or CPU layout pointer.
